description: Na₃Al₂P₂O₈F₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmc2₁ space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four O and three F atoms. There are two shorter (2.39 Å) and two longer (2.46 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There is one shorter (2.45 Å) and two longer (2.47 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four O and three F atoms. There are two shorter (2.40 Å) and two longer (2.48 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There is one shorter (2.43 Å) and two longer (2.46 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form distorted NaO₄F₂ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with six equivalent AlO₄F₂ octahedra and edges with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-57°. There are two shorter (2.46 Å) and two longer (2.55 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.39 Å. Al is bonded to four O and two F atoms to form AlO₄F₂ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one AlO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with three equivalent NaO₄F₂ pentagonal pyramids, and corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 5°. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-1.95 Å. There is one shorter (1.85 Å) and one longer (1.90 Å) Al-F bond length. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent AlO₄F₂ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄F₂ pentagonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-45°. There are two shorter (1.54 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Al, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Al, and one P atom. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two equivalent Al atoms. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Al atom.
